delivery.runtime_consumer: Local origin ASGI and gateway admission
delivery.dependencies: Exact staged bytes, immutable certificate, nonce-bound primary and veto proofs
delivery.operational_limitations: Supported browser/route matrix and customer-enrolled live TLS are unavailable.

supply.runtime_consumer: Native build, dependency checks and synthesis
supply.dependencies: Pinned Python wheels, Node lockfiles, GitHub-hosted native runners
supply.operational_limitations: No deployed signed AMI/CDK assembly or independent build provenance receipt.

case.runtime_consumer: Authenticated case HTTP handlers and console case panels
case.dependencies: OIDC session, case membership, tenant RLS, scoped evidence, case audit
case.operational_limitations: Existing metadata and timeline cover a subset of evidence classes and projections.

intake.runtime_consumer: Public preflight and scoped staging upload/finalize handlers
intake.dependencies: Tenant session, declarations, quotas, immutable object version IDs and staging signer
intake.operational_limitations: Storage evidence writer needs trusted independently acquired bytes.

artifact.runtime_consumer: Content manifest API plus reference verifier and exact-version reader
artifact.dependencies: Staging rows, byte hashes, S3 versions and future independent signer
artifact.operational_limitations: No separately operated consumer, independent signed manifest or builder materials.

guest.runtime_consumer: Offline guest CLI and instrumentable bridge controllers
guest.dependencies: Pinned lease, raw devices, static parser, AWS inventory or synthetic fixtures
guest.operational_limitations: Independently enrolled AWS roles, a qualified AMI and live containment/reachability evidence are unavailable.

authority.runtime_consumer: Privileged PostgreSQL command and protocol reference interfaces
authority.dependencies: Locked primary, governance, staging proof, archive, review and witness
authority.operational_limitations: No independently operated private authority ingress and no qualified target.

witness.runtime_consumer: Witness reference verifier and private registration command
witness.dependencies: Exact versioned store, committed primary selection, external root and signatures
witness.operational_limitations: External account custody, conditional version retention and live immutable-archive drills are unavailable.

observer.runtime_consumer: Observer reference HTTP reader and PostgreSQL observation command
observer.dependencies: Enrolled origin route, independent signing key and current revision
observer.operational_limitations: No live customer path or independently operated observation schedule.

ai.runtime_consumer: Case evidence panel computes summary of loaded pages
ai.operational_limitations: Processor dispatch, consent storage and a qualified provider are absent.

trust.runtime_consumer: Shadow server plus guarded reference primitives
trust.dependencies: Typed messages, credential pins, independent service identity and provenance
trust.operational_limitations: Authenticated end-to-end deployment and independent host/administrator evidence are unavailable.

origin.runtime_consumer: Origin binding contract, gateway and local CloudFront synthesis
origin.dependencies: Approved hostname, route proof, expiry, gateway configuration
origin.operational_limitations: No enrolled DNS/TLS, cache/failover ownership proof or real origin drill.

enrollment.dependencies: Offline roots, identified independent people and customer target profile
enrollment.operational_limitations: No signed security/customer scope or review-device/custodian enrollment.

lease.runtime_consumer: Scoped scan API and private lease/result command interfaces
lease.dependencies: Native PostgreSQL, nonce/fence, SQS plan and attempt controller
lease.operational_limitations: No qualified live SQS consumer or enrolled worker infrastructure.

scan.runtime_consumer: Offline guest analysis and trusted result-validation interfaces
scan.dependencies: Pinned grammar, sealed inert inputs and reviewer baseline trust
scan.operational_limitations: Full golden corpus and approved source materials are unavailable. Supported static analysis is bounded.

facts.runtime_consumer: Existing verifier/receipt interfaces cover only narrow fact families
facts.dependencies: Exact external object versions, typed enrolled issuer and stable event ID
facts.operational_limitations: General issuer-event storage, retention and correction lifecycle are absent.

review.runtime_consumer: Independent-signature verifier and downstream receipt commands
review.dependencies: Review subject, keys, person/custody evidence, challenge and enrolled client
review.operational_limitations: Native review client and credential enrollment service are absent.

veto.runtime_consumer: Signed veto check, scoped containment assessor and incident command
veto.dependencies: Independent root, gateway inventory, cutoff receipts and trusted clock
veto.operational_limitations: Live external stop, independent acknowledgements and admission drain are unqualified.

platform.runtime_consumer: Native shadow HTTP, scoped database and signed codec consumers
platform.operational_limitations: Common wire/route conventions vary across reference protocols and deployed paths.

identity.runtime_consumer: Browser OIDC and case/asset session handlers
identity.dependencies: Pinned IdP metadata, cookies, CSRF, membership revision and PostgreSQL
identity.operational_limitations: Protected reviewer and service identity enrollment are incomplete.

incident.runtime_consumer: Incident commands and operations degradation projection
incident.dependencies: Scoped authority, transition revision, signed confirmation and outbox
incident.operational_limitations: Requires enrolled independent responder and receipt archive for action evidence.

operations.dependencies: Queue, scan, incident and authority projections
operations.operational_limitations: No private readiness/metrics and no operator paging deployment.

data.dependencies: Primary PostgreSQL, tenant scope, composite references and roles
data.operational_limitations: Full privacy schema, migration qualification and independent ownership reviews are open.

audit.runtime_consumer: Domain mutations, local reconciliation and outbox runner
audit.dependencies: Native PostgreSQL, stream locks, external immutable receipt and consumer
audit.operational_limitations: No independently retained production archive or real replay/consumer drill.

privacy.runtime_consumer: Case membership enforcement and recovery inventory are existing foundations
privacy.dependencies: Retention policy, object version custody, tenant withdrawal and independently retained tombstones
privacy.operational_limitations: No general retention and deletion service or signed external tombstone store.

console.dependencies: Scoped BFF sessions and current case/operations projections
console.operational_limitations: Browser tests use synthetic data. Several views and inert source byte contracts are absent.

cloud.dependencies: CDK native assembly and future independently managed AWS accounts
cloud.operational_limitations: Synthesis cannot establish live IAM, endpoint reachability, customer infrastructure or custody.

capacity.runtime_consumer: Local native page benchmark and request/attempt bounds
capacity.dependencies: Disposable PostgreSQL or synthetic proof/guest workload
capacity.operational_limitations: No target topology, trained operator drills or qualified workload measurements.

recovery.runtime_consumer: Standalone assessor exercised by synthetic tests only
recovery.dependencies: Independent custodians, network controls, old writer fence, immutable provider facts
recovery.operational_limitations: Collector, corroborated signed records, live restoration and newly enrolled identities are unavailable.

verification.regression: 28 synthetic recovery preflight cases, including strict attestation types, generation range and independent serving/notification controls.

qual.runtime_consumer: Independent security, customer, identity and operator release review
qual.dependencies: Matrix C oracles, frozen artifacts and independent sign-off
qual.operational_limitations: Matrix C detailed oracles and independent signed qualification results were unavailable.

export.runtime_consumer: GET /v1/cases/{case_id}/exports with explicit evidence_metadata projection. Streaming API clients must validate the end record.
export.dependencies: Active BFF session, case membership, tenant RLS and indexed linked evidence metadata.
export.operational_limitations: No frontend download workflow. No binary, excerpt, source diff, incident or other evidence projection. No snapshot across requests.

verification.regression: Native PostgreSQL test_cases_are_membership_scoped_and_evidence_is_asset_bound exercises approved scope, continuation and mid-response revocation.
